assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC in its circumcircle with centre O, the gray lines a, b, c through O parallel to BC, CA, AB, the dashed circle on diameter AO through A1, A2 and X, and the blue triangle XYZ formed by the feet X, Y, Z on a, b, c.

difficulty_rationale: Seeing that each circle has diameter AO (so X is a foot of a perpendicular) is the key insight; expressing the three feet as projections of one point and comparing all three sides needs substantial further work.
